messages.content: "請你先計算從一副有52張牌的牌組中抽出一張紅心的機率，其中有13張紅心，然後再計算從同一副牌組中抽出一張皇后的機率，其中有4個皇后。之後，能否找出藝術家'巴勃羅·畢卡索'最近的作品，並提供詳細描述？最後，能否找出在紐約12月舉行且評分高的最受歡迎的雕塑展覽？"

function.name: get_sculpture_info
function.description: Retrieves the most recent artwork by a specified artist with its detailed description. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of the sculpture. This is optional. Default is the current year.

detail.description: If True, it provides detailed description of the sculpture. Defaults to False.

function.name: find_exhibition
function.description: Locate the most popular exhibitions based on criteria like location, time, art form, and user ratings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where the exhibition is held, e.g., New York, NY.

art_form.description: The form of art the exhibition is displaying e.g., sculpture.

month.description: The month of exhibition. Default value will return upcoming events.

user_ratings.description: Select exhibitions with user rating threshold. Default is 'average'.

function.name: card_game_probability_calculate
function.description: Calculate the probability of drawing a certain card or suit from a deck of cards. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

total_cards.description: Total number of cards in the deck.

desired_cards.description: Number of cards in the deck that satisfy the conditions.

cards_drawn.description: Number of cards drawn from the deck.
